title: The Vanishing Coin
description: Make a coin disappear using the classic French Drop technique. Master the misdirection and timing — the secret is in the fingers, not the coin.

title: Ambitious Card
description: A card repeatedly rises above the deck on its own. This classic involves a simple false cut and a repeated gesture that fools the eye every time.

title: The Invisible Deck
description: Your spectator shuffles and selects a card, yet you always know exactly which one it is. The deck appears truly random — no forces, no switches.

title: Sponge to the Ear
description: A classic stage prop trick — a sponge ball travels from hand to hand, then appears behind the ear. Simple gimmick, huge laughs.

title: Cups and Balls
description: The oldest magic trick in history. Balls appear under cups, vanish, and travel between them. Master this and you've mastered the foundation of all magic.

title: Card to Pocket
description: A freely chosen card literally walks across the table and jumps into your spectator's pocket. No sleight of hand required.
